cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster, no matter how confident you feel.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimlik ichib mashina haydash - qanchalik o'zingizga ishonsangiz ham, ofat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat shundayki, yomon natijalarga olib kelishi aniq.

cards.ex: The airport was totally chaotic after the snowstorm, with flights delayed for hours.
cards.exUz: Qor bo'roni tufayli aeroport butunlay tartibsiz edi, reyslar soatlab kechiktirildi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari tartibsiz, chalkash va nazorat qilinishi qiyin.

cards.ex: If the government collapses, the country could descend into chaos.
cards.exUz: Agar hukumat qulasa, mamlakat tartibsizlikka tushishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tartibsiz, chalkash va nazoratdan chiqib ketishi.

cards.ex: The new production line runs like clockwork; we haven't had a single hiccup.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishlab chiqarish liniyasi soat kabi ishlaydi; bizda hech qanday muammo bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi tashkil etilgan va muammosiz ishlaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: The police were called in to restore order after the protest turned violent.
cards.exUz: Namoyish zo'ravonlikka aylangandan so'ng, tartibni tiklash uchun politsiya chaqirildi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsizlikdan keyin vaziyatni nazoratga olish va tartibga solish.

cards.ex: He might seem disorganized, but there's a method to his madness; he always gets things done.
cards.exUz: U tartibsiz ko'rinishi mumkin, lekin uning aqldan ozishida usul bor; u har doim hamma narsani bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: G'alati yoki tartibsiz ko'rinadigan narsada yashirin maqsad borligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The political situation is in a state of flux after the recent elections.
cards.exUz: So'nggi saylovlardan keyin siyosiy vaziyat doimiy o'zgarish holatida.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy o'zgarishda bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Regular meetings help keep things in check and ensure everyone is on the same page.
cards.exUz: Muntazam uchrashuvlar hamma narsani nazorat ostida ushlab turishga va hamma bir xil fikrda bo'lishiga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haddan tashqari rivojlanishiga yoki yomonlashuviga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: The investigation uncovered a tangled web of deceit and corruption.
cards.exUz: Tergov yolg'on va korruptsiyaning chigal to'rini ochib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab va chalkash vaziyat, odatda yolg'on yoki sir tufayli.

cards.ex: Many good ideas fall by the wayside because of lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yaxshi g'oyalar moliyalashtirish yetishmasligi sababli e'tibordan chetda qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning unut bo'lishi yoki to'xtatilishi.

cards.ex: I wanted to set the record straight about what really happened that night.
cards.exUz: O'sha kuni kechasi nima bo'lgani haqida haqiqatni oydinlashtirmoqchi edim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunchani yoki yolg'on xabarni tuzatish.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread any further.
cards.exUz: Biz bu mish-mishlarni tarqalishidan oldin ildizida yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani boshlanishidayoq to'xtatib qo'yish, rivojlanishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: Let's sit down and try to straighten things out between us.
cards.exUz: Keling, o'tirib, o'zimiz o'rtasidagi muammolarni hal qilishga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish yoki chalkashliklarni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: Their business empire turned out to be a house of cards, built on debt and lies.
cards.exUz: Ularning biznes imperiyasi qarz va yolg'onga asoslangan qog'oz uyi bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan qulaydigan kuchsiz, beqaror tizim yoki reja.

cards.ex: The party got completely out of hand, and the neighbors called the police.
cards.exUz: Kechki ziyofat butunlay nazoratdan chiqib ketdi va qo'shnilar politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan darajaga yetishi.

cards.ex: The firefighters finally managed to bring the blaze under control.
cards.exUz: O't o'chiruvchilar nihoyat olovni nazoratga olishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni boshqarishga qodir bo'lish.

cards.ex: There's a fine line between being assertive and being aggressive.
cards.exUz: O'z fikrini himoya qilish va tajovuzkor bo'lish o'rtasida nozik chegara bor.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida farqni aniqlash qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He completely lost the plot after his divorce and started making terrible decisions.
cards.exUz: U ajrashganidan keyin butunlay aqlini yo'qotdi va dahshatli qarorlar qabul qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatini nazorat qila olmaslik, g'alati ishlar qilish.

cards.ex: The negotiations failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, hech qanday taraqqiyot bo'lmagan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The team turned the tables in the second half and won the game.
cards.exUz: Jamoa ikkinchi bo'limda vaziyatni o'z foydasiga o'zgartirdi va o'yinda g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni o'z foydasiga o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: I'm in a bit of a pickle because I've lost my passport.
cards.exUz: Men pasportimni yo'qotganim sababli biroz noqulay ahvoldaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Opening up that investigation could open a real can of worms.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tergovni boshlash muammolar yig'indisini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yechimi qiyin bo'lgan muammolar to'plami, yangi muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He's a law unto himself and never listens to anyone's advice.
cards.exUz: U o'z qonuniga ega va hech kimning maslahatiga quloq solmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining shaxsiy qoidalariga ko'ra harakat qiladigan odam, boshqalarni mensimaydi.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking; things aren't that bad.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz va vahima qilishni to'xtatishingiz kerak; vaziyat unchalik yomon emas.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: I tried to smooth things over between them, but they're still angry.
cards.exUz: Men ular o'rtasidagi vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildim, lekin ular hali ham jahldor.
cards.uzDef: Janjal yoki kelishmovchilikdan keyin vaziyatni yaxshilashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The city was in complete gridlock after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin shaharda to'liq tiqilinch yuzaga keldi.
cards.uzDef: Harakatlanish imkonsiz bo'lgan yo'ldagi qattiq tiqilinch; shuningdek, kelishuvga erishib bo'lmaydigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The elevator is out of order, so we'll have to take the stairs.
cards.exUz: Lift ishlamayapti, shuning uchun biz zinadan chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishlaydigan yoki ishdan chiqqan.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline that we're excited about.
cards.exUz: Bizda ish jarayonida bir nechta yangi loyihalar bor, biz ulardan xursandmiz.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan yoki ishlab chiqilayotgan.

cards.ex: Their marriage started to fall apart after he lost his job.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotganidan keyin ularning nikohi parchalanib keta boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Qismlarga bo'linish, ishlamay qolish yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: The party is a house divided, with factions arguing over policy.
cards.exUz: Partiya bo'lingan uy, guruhlar siyosat bo'yicha bahslashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ichida kelishmovchiliklar yoki nizolar mavjud bo'lgan guruh yoki tashkilot.
